name: Color Match
description: How well can you differentiate between colors? In this game, you'll be presented with a color and four options to choose from. Your goal is to select the correct color that matches the one displayed. As you progress, the colors become more similar, making it harder to distinguish between them. Test your color perception and see how many levels you can complete!

name: Memory Tile
description: Test your memory and focus in this fast-paced tile memory challenge! A grid of tiles will briefly highlight in a specific pattern before disappearing. Your goal is to recall and select the correct tiles in the right order. With each correct round, the sequence grows longer, making the game progressively more challenging.

name: Number Sequence
description: Test your memory and focus in this fast-paced number sequence challenge! A sequence of numbers will briefly appear on the screen, and your goal is to recall and input the sequence correctly. With each correct answer, the length of the sequence increases, making the game progressively more difficult. How long can you keep up as the numbers become harder to remember?

name: Reaction Time
description: Get ready to experience the thrill of a Formula 1 start! Are you faster than famous F1 drivers? Click the shape when the 5 red lights go out. Put your reflexes to the test and see how fast you really are.

name: Speed Typing
description: How many words can you type in 60 seconds? Start typing and the timer begins automatically. No countdown, just go! When the time’s up, your score in Words Per Minute (WPM) will reveal how fast your fingers really are. Can you beat your personal best?

name: Stroop Effect
description: Put your brain to the test with this classic psychological challenge! A color word will appear on screen — but there's a catch: the word is written in a different ink color. Your goal is to identify the ink color, not what the word says. Stay sharp, override your instincts, and see how quickly you can master the conflict between what you read and what you see.

name: Word Recall
description: Challenge your memory and attention in this word recall game! You'll be presented with one word at a time, and your task is to decide whether you've seen the word before or not. As the game progresses, more words will be introduced, and you'll need to rely on your memory to avoid making mistakes. How long can you keep track of the words? Test your recall skills and see how many rounds you can complete!
